elements.label: White king chess piece shattering into fragments
elements.change_other: shatter (rigid-body fracture, fragments fall and scatter)

sfx_review.label: swoosh_reverse
sfx_review.note: Rising swell ahead of the motion-blurred whip into this shot (f183); plausibly a reverse swoosh lead-in, not tied to the shatter itself.

sfx_review.label: impact
sfx_review.note: Clear broadband vertical onset ~185 ms before the visible fracture; reads as the hit that breaks the king. The shatter crackle follows as diffuse broadband texture during the event.

pattern.description: In a shallow-depth-of-field 3D chess scene, the white king fractures in place and collapses into a pile of faceted white shards while the surrounding black pieces stay still.
pattern.why_premium: A physically simulated fracture with real-feeling weight, faceted shards and tactile CG materials turns a narrative beat (the opponent's king is beaten) into a punchy visual punchline, sold by a synced impact hit.

build_hint.gsap: Pre-render the fracture as a 3D sim (image sequence/video); in HyperFrames play it with a hard cut-in, then add gsap.fromTo(shardsLayer, {y: 0}, {y: 6, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}) and a 2-frame camera shake (x: +/-4, ease: 'steps(2)') on impact.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> or an image sequence of the rendered shatter; optional impact shake translateX = 4 * Math.sin(frame * 3) * Math.max(0, 1 - (frame - impactFrame) / 6) for 6 frames.

notes: Rendered 3D footage; the motion is a physics sim, so easing is not meaningful. f183 is motion blur from the incoming shot transition, not part of the shatter. b02 (tiny right-edge box) is noise and is not listed.
